title: Content Loops
description: A data-source-driven repeater. Register pluggable LoopEntitySource backends (each declares fields + an async fetch returning { items, totalItems }), then drop <ContentLoop source sourceId filters orderBy variants={[A, B]} /> to render a child component per item, round-robining items across variants (item i -> variants[i % n]). Ships the source registry (namespaced ids, no shadowing), createMockLoopSource so it runs env-free, none/infinite pagination via useLoopPagination (Load more button), and a generic LoopItem field-bag. Write your own source that fetches from Convex/REST and register it — the contract is identical to the mock. Harvested + decoupled from the Instatic CMS base.loop engine (publisher / page-tree / entryStack machinery stripped to props).

axes.description: Single page, or accumulate pages behind a Load more button
